query: I just got back from picking up my new rescue puppy this morning, he’s a tiny golden retriever mix with the cutest white patch on his chest, and he spent the whole car ride curled up in my lap licking my wrist. I stopped at that new coffee shop on 5th street on the way home too, and their lavender oat milk latte was so good I already signed up for their rewards program. I also spent 20 minutes picking out a new soft dog bed for him from the pet store next door, it’s blue and has little bone patterns all over it. But anyway, I’m having an issue with my phone where I can’t get any mobile data to work at all right now. I checked and airplane mode is turned on, my network preference is set wrong, I think my APN MMS settings got messed up somehow, data mode is off, my SIM card might not be seated right, and I’m currently abroad right now with roaming turned off. Can you help me fix this?
